Reporting to the TSS (Technical Success Services) Practice Manager, Cloud Applications Consultant is responsible for being part of the technical team that involves and complete ownership of technical delivery including administration and management of the OpenText Exstream product suite for our worldwide customers.
  
Looking for a successful candidate who will be a technically resourceful individual with the ability to provide exceptional customer support in a challenging and rewarding environment.
  
You will be joining a growing team that provides world\-class operational support including hands\-on troubleshooting and administration to a variety of enterprise customers. You will be required to collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure that Service Levels are met, and customer satisfaction is achieved.
  
  

**What the role offers:**  

* 2 \- 5 years of prior experience working on relevant technologies
* A minimum of 2\+ years of previous experience working within a technical support or consulting environment working with the Exstream CCM platform and associated technologies. Working experience on Exstream design manager, Communication Server, Orchestration, Empower, OTDS, and Command Center.
* Experience with Exstream CN Knowledge is an asset.
* Extreme Knowledge of configuration of ECM integration with Communications Server, OTDS installation, configuration, and integration with Exstream.
* Ability to understand product integration with 3rd party applications in complex environments.
* Proficient Knowledge in, OS \- Win/Linux \- OS fundamentals, troubleshooting fundamentals, Logs, DB \- MS SQL, Oracle \- Write basic queries, API basics.
* Experience in delivering service within an ITIL\-based service delivery model.
* Programming/scripting is helpful, (e.g., SQL, .sh/.bat, Java, JavaScript).
* Familiarity with configuration and management of web/application servers (IIS, Apache, Tomcat, JBoss, etc.).
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm.
* Strong analytical skills combined with the ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with geographically distributed teams.
* Strong desire to provide exceptional customer support efficiently with a high focus on first\-call resolution.
* Willingness to work in shifts during weekdays and on\-call during weekends.


**What you need to succeed:**  

* Utilizing exceptional written and verbal communication skills while demonstrating a high level of customer focus and empathy.
* Responding to and solving customer technical requests, showing an understanding of the customer's managed hosted environment and applications within the OpenText Cloud, enabling resolution of complex technical issues.
* Operating, managing, and administering production Exstream applications while following documented policies and procedures.
* Responding to and troubleshooting alerts from monitoring of applications, servers, and devices sufficient to meet service level agreements.
* Collaborating on cross\-functional and cross\-product technical issues with a variety of resources including Product support, IT, Network Operations, and Professional Services.
* Working under general guidance with results reviewed periodically, seeking approval from others on matters outside of job or role as needed.


**One last thing:**  

OpenText is more than just a corporation, it's a global community where trust is foundational, the bar is raised, and outcomes are owned. Join us on our mission to drive positive change through privacy, technology, and collaboration. At OpenText, we don't just have a culture; we have character. Choose us because you want to be part of a company that embraces innovation and empowers its employees to make a difference.
  
  

OpenText's efforts to build an inclusive work environment go beyond simply complying with applicable laws. Our Employment Equity and Diversity Policy provides direction on maintaining a working environment that is inclusive of everyone, regardless of culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.
  
If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact us athr@opentext.com. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

title: Manager, Platform Engineering
description:
**About Vista Equity Partners**
===============================



Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology\-enabled businesses. With over $100B in assets under management and a portfolio of 90\+ software product companies worldwide, Vista accelerates growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long\-term partnership. In India, Vista’s presence continues to expand with 45\+ portfolio companies employing more than 17,000 professionals across technology, product, customer success, and operations — reinforcing India’s strategic role as a hub of innovation and talent within the Vista ecosystem.



Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is embedding Generative AI across its global portfolio — enabling companies to integrate intelligent, responsible AI into products, operations, and decision\-making. This initiative is strengthened through portfolio\-wide learning programs, leadership workshops, and AI hackathons that foster innovation, build fluency, and accelerate practical AI adoption across teams.


**About Amtech**
================



Amtech is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems streamline order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics — empowering customers to drive efficiency, reduce costs, and improve operational performance. With a strong commitment to innovation and customer success, Amtech delivers reliable technology backed by deep industry expertise.



With Vista’s investment and strategic guidance, we combine the agility of a growing technology organization with the scale, stability, and career mobility of a global software ecosystem.


**Our Employee Value Proposition**  

  

At Amtech, our people are our greatest differentiator. We create an environment where you can:  

  

**Purpose**  

Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission\-critical enterprise software used by industry\-leading organizations.  

**Growth**  

Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross\-portfolio opportunities through Vista’s global network — accelerating both technical and managerial career paths.  

**Culture**  

Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people\-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision.  

**Innovation**  

Engage with cutting\-edge technologies, including AI\-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing financial systems and operational processes across the business.


**Role Description**
====================



Amtech is executing an all\-in AWS strategy: migrating our flagship Encore ERP to a multi\-account, account\-per\-customer AWS architecture, operating LabelTraxx as a multi\-tenant SaaS platform, and retiring legacy private\-cloud infrastructure over time. Platform Engineering owns the landing zone, infrastructure as code, and the golden\-path tooling that product teams build on, and the reliability of everything that runs on it.



The Manager, Platform Engineering (India) leads the India Cloud and Platform SRE teams: the engineers who build the AWS platform and the engineers who keep it running. You own the people, the delivery, and the day\-to\-day technical leadership of that group under the guidance of the VP, working alongside the Cloud Architect, who owns platform architecture. The scope spans two engineering disciplines and a direct interface to IT/IS/PE leadership and vendors.


This is a player\-coach role by design: leadership first, hands\-on second. Leadership means hiring and building the team, developing engineers, running the operating cadence, and representing Platform Engineering within IT/IS/PE and to partner functions. Hands\-on means staying close enough to the code and the incidents to make good calls, review the changes that matter most, and lead incident response in India hours. As the team matures, the balance shifts further toward leadership without leaving the technical work behind.


You will work daily with the U.S.\-based Senior Manager who leads Customer SRE, the Senior SRE who owns the reliability standards both SRE teams operate on, the Sr. Director of Information Security, and the VP. This role is the first people\-leadership position in Platform Engineering India.


**SCOPE \& AUTHORITY**


* Leads hiring for the India Cloud and Platform SRE teams in partnership with Talent Acquisition; offers follow Amtech's approval process. The role leads interviews and makes the hiring recommendation for each open India position.
* Owns performance, leveling, and development decisions for direct reports within Amtech's leveling framework.
* Sets sprint priorities and capacity allocation for the India teams within the Platform Engineering roadmap.
* Holds incident command for platform incidents in India hours.
* Runs the architecture review and holds the team to its outcomes; the Cloud Architect approves architecture decisions, and decisions affecting security controls require Information Security sign\-off.
* Leads technical evaluation of platform vendors and tooling with the Cloud Architect; recommends spend and contract changes to the VP, who holds approval.
* Participates in the IT/IS/PE leadership team as needed; Platform Engineering's representative in India site leadership forums.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**
===================


**People Leadership**


* Lead, hire, and develop the India Cloud and Platform SRE teams, a team that is growing through 2027 with hosted customer count and product engineering headcount and that this role hires into from day one.
* Own performance management, career development, and leveling under Amtech's leveling framework; grow senior engineers into technical leads and future managers.
* Set the operating cadence for the India teams: sprint ceremonies, on\-call rotations, triage duty, and the follow\-the\-sun handoff with the U.S.
* Build a team culture of ownership, blameless postmortems, and written decision\-making that holds across time zones.
* Give engineers credit publicly and feedback privately.


**Architecture \& Technical Strategy**


* Deliver the AWS platform roadmap set with the Cloud Architect, who owns architecture: multi\-account organization, landing zone, networking, identity, and the account\-per\-customer Encore tenancy model.
* Plan and deliver Encore\-on\-AWS environment builds (temporary, production, demo) on the shared golden IaC stack, and LabelTraxx platform work, against the roadmap.
* Run the architecture review: decisions are recorded as ADRs, reviewed with the Senior SRE, and approved by the Cloud Architect. Make sure decisions are made on time and carried through by the team.
* Evaluate and integrate emerging capabilities, including AI\-assisted and agentic engineering tooling, within Amtech's AI governance guardrails.


**Platform Engineering \& Delivery**


* Hold the technical bar for infrastructure code: enforce module standards set with the Cloud Architect, review the highest\-blast\-radius changes, and write code where it unblocks the team.
* Operate and enforce standards for CI/CD (GitHub Actions), progressive delivery, environment promotion, and secrets management.
* Drive automation of environment provisioning so a new hosted customer is a pipeline run, not a project; publish and hit onboarding time targets.
* Own delivery against the Platform Engineering roadmap: sprint commitments, capacity budgets (strategic versus tactical), and the response commitments made to requesters.


**Reliability \& Operations**


* Own delivery of production reliability for the shared platform in India hours, operating on the SLO frameworks, observability architecture (OpenTelemetry, OpenObserve, CloudWatch), and PagerDuty service models set by the Senior SRE.
* Hold authority to deviate from a reliability standard during an active incident, restore the standard when the incident closes, and raise a postmortem item to ratify or revert the change. Propose standard changes to the Senior SRE, who decides; the VP arbitrates.
* Lead major incident response for platform incidents in India hours; own postmortems and the remediation backlog.
* Own patching, backup and restore testing, disaster recovery exercises, and capacity management on a published calendar.
* Extend observability to AI workloads so usage, performance, and spend are visible in the same plane as compute.


**Security, Compliance \& Cost**


* Implement and enforce security architecture with Information Security and the Cloud Architect: IAM boundaries, network segmentation, encryption, and data governance for customer data.
* Ensure the platform satisfies SOC 2 and ISO 27001 obligations by design, with audit evidence generated through automation.
* Drive FinOps outcomes with Finance: tagging governance, right\-sizing, Savings Plans coverage, unit cost visibility, and input to the AWS enterprise commit.
* Surface technical and delivery risk to the VP early: sequencing, vendor dependencies, and single points of failure.


**AI Competency**


* Adopt agentic and AI\-assisted engineering workflows for the team within the autonomy tiers, guardrails, and auditability set by Platform Engineering; measure productivity against baselines.
* Apply the validation layers (schema, rules, model\-graded, human review) appropriate to each change by blast radius.
* Prevent AI\-generated code from degrading platform quality at fleet scale: evaluation harnesses, complexity metrics, and AI\-attributed defect tracking.
* Mentor engineers in safe, high\-leverage AI usage; enforce data classification policy in all AI\-assisted work.


**Cross\-Functional Leadership**


* Partner with the Customer SRE leader so the platform the India team builds and the environments Customer SRE runs evolve together.
* Partner with the Senior SRE on reliability standards: implement and enforce them in India and feed operational learning back.
* Serve as senior technical counterpart to AWS, consulting partners, and third\-party providers on funded programs in India hours.
* Report team delivery, reliability, and risk clearly to IT/IS/PE leadership; support integration work for acquisitions.


Ensure knowledge is durable: documentation, runbooks, and deliberate succession planning so no platform capability depends on one person, including you


**WORKING HOURS**



Core hours are India business hours. The role carries a scheduled overlap window with U.S. leadership for architecture reviews and leadership syncs, set in the team operating cadence. Incident command applies in India hours; weekend paging is P0 only and rotates across the team rather than resting on this role.


**QUALIFICATIONS**


**Must have**


* Hands\-on AWS platform experience in a multi\-account environment: landing zones, account vending, IAM, and networking, at a level that lets you review your team's work credibly.
* Strong Terraform and IaC experience: working in a shared module ecosystem with testing and versioning discipline.
* 2\+ years leading engineers as a people manager with direct responsibility for hiring, performance, and development, within 12\+ years of progressive engineering experience.
* Experience leading production operations under SLOs: on\-call design, incident command, postmortems, and observability with OpenTelemetry or equivalent.


**Strongly preferred**


* Designed AI\-assisted or agentic engineering systems with guardrails, autonomy tiers, and measured ROI; L4\+ AI competency by industry frameworks.
* Strong software engineering foundation (Python, Go, or similar) and fluency with modern CI/CD (GitHub Actions or equivalent).
* Working command of cloud security architecture and compliance\-driven design (SOC 2, ISO 27001\).


**Preferred**


* Track record of building and retaining a high\-performing engineering team in a distributed, multi\-time\-zone organization.
* Communicates decisions in writing clearly enough that executives act on them and engineers execute them without a meeting.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrated skills.
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer Professional.
* Experience with multi\-tenant SaaS and account\-per\-customer tenancy economics.
* Experience architecting and executing large migrations (data center or private cloud to AWS), including ERP\-class or other stateful enterprise workloads.
* Experience in a private equity portfolio company, M\&A integration, or investor\-facing technical diligence.
* Experience building an engineering team in India for a U.S.\-headquartered company, including leveling frameworks and retention programs.
* FinOps practice experience: tagging governance, Savings Plans strategy, cost allocation, enterprise commit negotiation.
* Experience establishing AI/LLM platform capabilities or agent\-based automation under formal governance.


**SUCCESS IN THE FIRST YEAR**


* Every India Cloud and Platform SRE engineer has a named manager, a leveled role, a development plan, and a clear on\-call and triage rotation.
* The golden IaC stack has a documented owner and a succession plan; no platform capability depends on one person.
* New hosted customer environment provisioning time is published and improving quarter over quarter.
* SLO attainment for the shared platform is published monthly and meets target; platform incidents in India hours are led, resolved, and written up to the standard the Senior SRE sets for both SRE teams.
* The AWS enterprise commit is negotiated from a known baseline with FinOps discipline behind it.
* The team is one you would be proud to hand to the manager you are developing to replace you.

 **Why Join Amtech**
===================



At Amtech, you will drive meaningful financial impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista’s world\-class ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross\-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech’s financial operations and systems. Build your career with Amtech — backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture of Vista.

title: SAP Basis Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

The role will provide end\-to\-end technical coverage for SAP platforms, including system administration, installations/upgrades, performance monitoring, troubleshooting, transport/change management, scheduling, cloud infrastructure, and operational automation.


The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience in SAP Basis and a good understanding of modern SAP cloud technologies and enterprise scheduling/change\-management tools.  

  



Key Responsibilities:


* Provide end\-to\-end SAP Basis administration and operational support for SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SAP HANA, DB2\-based SAP systems, and SAP Cloud environments, ensuring high system availability and performance.
* Perform system monitoring, health checks, performance tuning, troubleshooting, incident resolution, and management of SAP work processes, background jobs, RFCs, user administration, and system parameters.
* Execute SAP installations, upgrades, support packs, kernel upgrades, system refreshes, migrations, copies, and lifecycle management activities across complex SAP landscapes.
* Administer and support SAP HANA databases, including performance monitoring, capacity management, backup and recovery, replication, patching, upgrades, and resolution of database\-related issues.
* Provide technical support for SAP workloads hosted on cloud platforms, collaborating with infrastructure, security, networking, and database teams to ensure availability, connectivity, disaster recovery, and successful cloud migration initiatives.
* Manage and support SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), including account administration, connectivity, integrations, service monitoring, troubleshooting, and integration with SAP ECC/S/4HANA environments.
* Administer SAP Solution Manager and SAP Cloud ALM for monitoring, alerting, reporting, lifecycle management, and change management processes, while driving adoption of cloud\-based operations capabilities.
* Oversee SAP transport management and enterprise job scheduling using tools such as Rev\-Trac, IBM Tivoli Workload Scheduler (TWS), V\-TOM, and Redwood, ensuring controlled releases, seamless production deployments, and reliable execution of SAP batch jobs and interfaces.

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.


Your Future at Kyndryl
  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior Administrator to Architect. We have training and upskilling programs that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands\-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with customers in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.  



  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.  



Required skills and experience


* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in SAP Basis Administration within large enterprise SAP environments.
* Strong expertise in SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SAP HANA, and SAP systems running on DB2\.
* Experience in SAP installations, upgrades, patching, kernel upgrades, system copies, migrations, performance tuning, monitoring, and incident management.
* Good understanding of SAP transport management, change control processes, high availability, backup/recovery, and disaster recovery.
* Experience supporting SAP workloads on cloud (IaaS/PaaS) platforms, with working knowledge of SAP BTP and cloud connectivity/integration concepts.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP Solution Manager, SAP Cloud ALM, and SAP monitoring and alerting tools.
* Experience with SAP change management solutions such as Rev\-Trac and enterprise scheduling tools including IBM Tivoli Workload Scheduler (TWS), V\-TOM, and Redwood.

Soft Skills


* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to resolve complex technical issues.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with SAP, infrastructure, database, cloud, security, and application teams.
* Strong ownership mindset and proactive problem\-solving approach.
* Ability to perform in production\-critical environments and manage high\-priority incidents.
* Strong documentation, knowledge\-sharing, and process improvement capabilities.
* Ability to work independently while coordinating effectively with global and cross\-functional teams.
  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Senior Software Engineering
description:
**Overview**  

In the Microsoft Industry Solutions Engineering (ISE) team, you won’t just build software; you’ll deliver real outcomes for some of the world’s most complex organizations.

  

We are a global team of world\-class engineers who have been working in a Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) model for more than a decade, embedding directly within customer teams to solve their toughest challenges, side\-by\-side, and shipping production\-ready solutions in days, not months.

  

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will bring strong software design and engineering expertise, building reliable systems and production\-ready services that turn ideas and data\-driven insights into scalable solutions. You’ll work in small, multidisciplinary crews alongside data scientists, product managers, and domain experts, owning the full lifecycle from design through to deployed solutions.

  

Our work is powered by AI, applying the mindset and tooling across the entire development lifecycle to move from idea to production in days while maintaining the highest standards of security, quality, and trust.

  

This role offers the opportunity to:

* Build reliable, production\-ready systems and services that turn ideas into scalable solutions
* Ship engineering work that directly influences business strategy and customer outcomes
* Collaborate with leading global organizations across industries
* Apply the latest advancements in AI and software engineering to solve problems at scale
  

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities*** Design, build, test, and operate production\-grade software and services that are secure, reliable, and scalable.
* Partner with customers and internal stakeholders to clarify requirements, define success metrics, and translate business needs into technical designs.
* Drive engineering best practices including code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, and documentation.
* Apply a security\-first mindset and follow Microsoft security and compliance requirements throughout design and delivery.
* Deliver customer outcomes end\-to\-end: prototype quickly, iterate with feedback, and land solutions that meet quality, performance, and maintainability goals.
* Build reusable components, reference implementations, and patterns that can be shared across teams and engagements.
* Learn and adapt in a fast\-moving environment, using experimentation and data to guide decisions and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate effectively across disciplines (engineering, data science, product, design, security) and contribute to an inclusive, respectful team culture.
* Lead technical workstreams by aligning stakeholders, breaking down ambiguous problems, and driving execution through to delivery.
* Embody our culture and values
 **Qualifications**  

Required/Minimum Qualifications (RQs/MQs)

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 4\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
* OR equivalent experience.
* Experience partnering directly with customers or internal stakeholders to deliver solutions end\-to\-end.
  

Additional or Preferred Qualifications (PQs)

* Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
* OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
* + OR equivalent experience.
	+ Experience designing, deploying, and operating AI or LLM\-based solutions, including prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented approaches, model tuning, evaluation, data quality, performance monitoring, and use of cloud AI platforms
	+ Enjoy travel and are comfortable with travel up to 25%  

Our team prides itself on embracing a growth mindset, inspiring excellence, and encouraging everyone to share their unique viewpoints and be their authentic selves. Join us and help create life\-changing innovations that impact billions around the world!

  

At Microsoft, we are seeking people who have a passion for the positive impact technology can have on communities and for making a difference in the world. In our team, you will find a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, personal and cultural experiences which are vital to our success with our customers. It’s an informal and flexible work environment and you’ll be welcome to work in the way that best enables you to get your job done.

  

We invest in your health, wellness, and financial future by offering a competitive package including a wide range of benefits built around your personal needs and those close to you.

  

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you need assistance and/or reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, please send a request via the Accommodation request form.

  

Benefits/perks listed below may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Microsoft and the country where you work.

  

\#ISEngineering


\#WSS


\#FDE

title: Control Operations Lead Data Management Services
description:
**Job Title: Control Operations Lead Data Management Services**


HSBC Data \& Analytics Office (DAO) promotes a data\-driven culture across HSBC through our strategy of:

* Protect: To protect our data we need robust policies for data management and enhanced governance e.g. data that is consumed from a trusted source, meets quality standards, and complies with regulatory obligations.
* Connect: Move to a data\-led culture through enhanced training including on the job opportunities. Our talent is the glue between protecting our data and unlocking value for our customers.
* Unlock. Value is unlocked when we deliver on the opportunities our well\-managed data presents e.g. improving customer / colleague experience, increasing revenue, commercialising our data, optimising capital, enhancing risk management or reducing costs.


We are hiring a Control Operations Lead \- DMS within Data Management Services (part of Data \& Analytics Office)


The Data function owns the bank’s data controls and the ecosystem that allows every business to implement them. Our vision is a self\-serve, automated route to meeting data control standards and delivering consistent, high\-quality data outcomes across HSBC.


The Control Operations Lead – DMS, leads the team responsible for implementing and operating data controls across business areas, in line with standards and designs set by the Data Design team. The role ensures controls are executed consistently, outcomes are evidenced to the required standard, and control performance is continuously improved through disciplined operational management.


The role owns the operational management of exceptions, ensuring issues are identified, triaged, investigated, resolved and closed in partnership with business and business\-aligned data teams.


Success depends on building and sustaining strong, outcome\-focused partnerships with key stakeholders across CIO areas, CDAO teams, Businesses, CCO and Risk to enable control implementation at pace, manage interdependencies, and ensure consistent adoption of control standards.

**Governance and Committee Memberships**

* The jobholder will continually reassess the operational risks associated with the role and inherent in the business, taking account of changing economic or market conditions, legal and regulatory requirements, operating procedures and practices, management restructurings, and the impact of new technology.
* The jobholder will also adhere to and be able to demonstrate adherence to internal controls. This will be achieved by adherence to all relevant procedures, keeping appropriate records and, where appropriate, by the timely implementation of internal and external audit points, including issues raised by external regulators.
* The jobholder will implement the Group compliance policy by containing compliance risk in liaison with Global Head of Compliance, Global Compliance Officer, Area Compliance Officer or Local Compliance Officer. The term ‘compliance’ embraces all relevant financial services laws, rules and codes with which the business has to comply.

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of data control implementation and day\-to\-day operation across business areas, ensuring adherence to agreed standards, timelines and outcomes. Translate control designs from the Data Design team into operational processes, procedures and run\-books that are executable, repeatable and auditable at scale.
* Drive consistent control execution across all operating locations, ensuring a single operating model with aligned quality standards, terminology, escalation routes and handovers. Ensure evidence and artefacts produced through control execution are complete, reproducible and meet requirements for Internal Audit, external audit and regulatory review.
* Own control performance management (MI, KPIs, control effectiveness measures), identifying themes, risks and opportunities, and driving continuous improvement. Establish and operate exception management (intake, triage, prioritisation, investigation, resolution and closure), ensuring clear ownership and timely remediation.Partner with Data Technology / Engineering and Product teams to shape tooling and workflow enhancements, using operational insight and effort data to prioritise improvements.
* Lead, develop and retain a high\-performing semi\-technical operations team; uplift capability across data governance, investigation, tooling fluency and operational discipline. Proactively identify and manage operational risk within the function, ensuring adherence to internal controls, policy requirements and timely closure of audit and regulatory findings.
* Lead a semi\-technical, multi\-geography team, ensuring consistent execution standards and shared ways of working across sites. Build a culture of ownership, operational excellence, transparency and learning; make it safe to surface issues early and solve them fast.
* Work collaboratively with CIO areas, CDAO teams, Businesses, CCO and Risk to deliver shared outcomes and maintain a strong control environment. Strengthen cross\-boundary teamwork with Data Design, Data Policy, Data Technology and Engineering, and broader transformation teams.

**To be successful you will:**

* Strong knowledge of data governance and data management (data quality, metadata, lineage, ownership, classification, privacy and retention) and their application in a regulated environment.
* Proven operations leadership capability: service management, run\-book discipline, capacity planning, quality assurance, and continuous improvement.
* Technical credibility to engage effectively with engineers and data platform teams; ability to interrogate data, understand datasets, and work with SQL / query\-based investigation (to an appropriate senior level).
* Strong audit and control mindset with experience preparing evidence and responding to audit / regulatory queries. Advanced stakeholder management and influencing skills, including delivery through matrixed organisations where formal authority is limited.
* 15\+ years’ experience in data operations, data governance, controls, risk and/or technology operations within financial services or similarly regulated environments.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent from a recognised university. Demonstrated success leading large teams, including managing managers, across multiple locations.
* Track record of delivering complex, cross\-functional outcomes under challenging timelines while maintaining control quality and colleague wellbeing. Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to present complex operational issues clearly to senior stakeholders and committees.

description:

mutual funds, wealth management, or banking.

Skills

Advanced mutual fund and market knowledge, including:  

Categories and sub\-categories of mutual funds as per regulatory  

classification.  

Client risk\-profiling questions and frameworks.  

Difference between arbitrage funds and hedge funds.  

Portfolio analysis techniques (asset allocation, diversification, overlap  

analysis).  

Reading and interpreting mutual fund factsheets.  

Strong presentation, negotiation, and objection\-handling skills for high\-value  

conversations.  

Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools and CRM systems.  

Personal Attributes  

Highly goal\-oriented with a track record of exceeding business targets.  

Strong ownership, accountability, and ability to work independently.

title: Manager, Account Management, AVS EU
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


About Amazon.com  

Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer\-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want \- low prices, vast selection, and convenience \- Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world\-class e\-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e\-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.  

About the Role  

Team Manager, Account Management  

As a Manager, Account Management as part of Amazon Vendor Services (AVS) Team of Retail Business Services, you will have the exciting opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy for managing Amazon AVS vendors.  

AVS team is looking for a bright, customer centric, driven, and creative people leader to join our team. The role leads a team of Account Managers responsible for managing business growth for some of the most influential Selling Partners (vendors) on Amazon, ensuring Selling Partner satisfaction with the program through a high level of service and operational standards. In this role, you will manage strategic joint business plans for Selling Partners across your team by collaborating with them to explore innovative ways to identify and execute new selection, merchandising, and operational improvement opportunities. You will interface internally with leaders from our Retail and Vendor Services teams and will be responsible for all aspects of the vendor’s business with Amazon. Your team will engage directly with multiple internal teams to optimize the product line for key manufacturers (vendors) on Amazon. The candidate thrives in an ambiguous environment where they must develop, implement and iterate data, processes, mechanisms and guardrails to improve the customer experience. Further, the candidate is a business owner who understands the key levers to drive business growth and can operationalize those levers across their team. They have a passion for people leadership and are at their best when they’re building, developing and managing high\-performing teams. Your team will utilize a wide range of skills and work across major functional areas such as site merchandising, buying, inventory management, finance, operations and online marketing, to drive the performance of strategic vendor partners at Amazon. In this role you will be focused on the strategic and operational aspects of managing the customer relationships with our vendors.  

You will lead the team to conceive, create and analyze a wide range of marketing and site merchandising efforts, to include marketing campaigns to grow the vendor’s traffic, brand awareness, customer conversion, and revenue on Amazon. title: Mainframe WAS MQ Systems Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

As a Mainframe WAS MQ Systems Administrator at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients – which means some of the biggest in the world.
  

  

There’s never a typical day as a System Administrator at Kyndryl, because no two projects are alike. You’ll be managing systems data for clients and providing day\-to\-day solutions and security compliance. You’ll oversee a queue of assignments and work directly with technicians, prioritizing tickets to deliver the best solutions to our clients.  



  

Key Responsibilities :  



  

* Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain IBM WebSphere Application Server (WAS) for z/OS and IBM MQ environments across development, test, and production systems.
* Administer MQ Queue Managers, Queue Sharing Groups (QSG), Sysplex environments, and Coupling Facility structures to ensure high availability and performance.
* Perform advanced troubleshooting of WAS and MQ issues, including JVM crashes, thread dumps, application failures, queue management, and performance bottlenecks.
* Monitor, tune, and optimize middleware infrastructure using tools such as OMEGAMON, RMF, MQ Explorer, Dynatrace, SYSVIEW, and BMC MainView.
* Design and implement MQ clustering, workload balancing, disaster recovery, backup, recovery, and business continuity solutions.
* Develop and maintain automation scripts using wsadmin (Jython), REXX, and shell scripting to improve operational efficiency and deployment processes.
* Implement and maintain security controls including SSL/TLS, JAAS, SAF integration, RACF policies, and MQ security best practices.
Participate in 24x7 on\-call support, major incident management, root cause analysis, documentation, and mentoring of junior administrators while driving continuous service improvements.  
* 

  

At Kyndryl, we're committed to providing the best possible service to our customers, and as a Systems Management Specialist, you'll be an integral part of that mission. So if you're passionate about technology and want to be part of a dynamic team that's shaping the future of IT infrastructure management – then this role is for you.  



  

Your Future at Kyndryl


Kyndryl's focus on providing innovative IT solutions to its customers means that in Systems Management, you will be working with the latest technology and will have the opportunity to learn and grow your skills. You may also have the opportunity to work on large\-scale projects and collaborate with other IT professionals from around the world.  



  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.  



  

  

Required Technical and Professional Expertise  



  

* 6 to 10 years of experience in IBM WebSphere Application Server for z/OS (WASz) administration and IBM MQ support.
* Strong experience in installation, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of IBM MQ environments.
* Hands\-on expertise with Queue Sharing Groups (QSG) and Coupling Facility technologies.
* Experience with MQ Explorer, Tivoli Monitoring, OMEGAMON, SYSVIEW, BMC MainView, MQATTACH, and ICC.
* Strong understanding of MQ clustering, distributed integration, and workload balancing concepts.
* Knowledge of workload management (WLM), high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity practices.
* Experience in system backup, recovery, performance analysis, and root\-cause troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of z/OS operating environments and middleware architecture.
Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.  
* 

  

  

Preferred Technical and Professional Experience  



  

* IBM Certified System Administrator – WebSphere Application Server for z/OS certification.
* Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise IBM Z environments with mission\-critical workloads.
* Experience with middleware upgrades, migrations, and modernization initiatives.
* Exposure to CICS, Db2, IMS, and other IBM Z middleware technologies.
Experience working in global delivery and 24x7 support environments.  
* 

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Director of Product Management
description:
**Director, Product Management – Core Data and Decision Intelligence**

**Target in India \| L7**

**About Us**


As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America’s leading retailers.


Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.


Target is investing in the next generation of **intelligent store experiences** that connect operational, digital and physical environments to create smarter outcomes for guests, team members and the business.


Our Core Intelligence Product teams are building the foundational capabilities that enable Target’s stores to **understand what is happening, anticipate what matters, recommend the right actions, and continuously learn from outcomes**.

**About the Job – Director, Product Management, Core Data and Decision Intelligence**


As Director of Product Management for **Core Intelligence**, you will help define and build the intelligence foundation powering the future of Target’s store operations and experiences.


You will lead a portfolio of highly technical products that bring together signals from operational systems, store environments and enterprise platforms; transform those signals into trusted context; and use data science, AI and intelligent systems to generate actionable recommendations at scale.


Your work will enable Target to move beyond static rules and fragmented signals toward **context\-aware, continuously learning intelligence** that can power multiple Store products, workflows and experiences.


Based in Target in India, you will lead Product Managers and partner deeply with Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, UX, Store Operations and experience Product teams to identify high\-value problems, develop reusable intelligence capabilities and translate technology investments into measurable outcomes for Target’s stores.

**Intelligence Product Vision \& Strategy**

* Define and execute the product vision and strategy for a portfolio of foundational Core Intelligence capabilities.
* Shape how operational and physical signals are transformed into trusted context, insights and recommendations that power Store experiences.
* Build scalable, reusable intelligence capabilities that can serve multiple products, workflows and operational domains.
* Identify opportunities to apply AI/ML, predictive intelligence, recommendation systems, simulation and emerging technologies to solve complex Store problems.
* Translate enterprise and Stores priorities into clear product strategies, investment choices, roadmaps and measurable outcomes.
* Balance near\-term business value with development of durable intelligence capabilities that can scale across Target.

**Product Discovery \& Intelligence Capability Development**

* Develop a deep understanding of Target’s store operating environment and identify opportunities where intelligence can meaningfully improve decisions and experiences.
* Establish strong discovery mechanisms across Product, Engineering, Data Science, UX and Operations to move from problems to hypotheses, experiments and scalable solutions.
* Drive rapid experimentation, simulation and learning to validate opportunities before scaling investments.
* Build feedback loops that allow intelligence capabilities to learn from outcomes and improve over time.
* Ensure intelligence products are designed for trust, explainability, interoperability, scalability and long\-term extensibility.

**Product \& Organizational Leadership**

* Lead and develop Product Managers across a portfolio of highly technical intelligence products.
* Create clear product ownership, accountability, success metrics and decision rights across the portfolio.
* Build a strong Product organization in Target in India with deep technical, strategic and business acumen.
* Coach Product Managers to lead through customer problems, discovery, evidence and outcomes rather than requirements and delivery.
* Foster a culture of experimentation, curiosity, ownership and continuous learning.
* Establish product operating mechanisms that enable empowered teams while maintaining alignment across a complex ecosystem.

**Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Influence**

* Build strong partnerships across Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, UX, Store Operations and experience Product teams.
* Influence senior leaders and partners across geographies without relying on direct authority.
* Translate complex technical and intelligence concepts into clear product and business narratives.
* Navigate ambiguity and competing priorities to create alignment around strategic investments.
* Help establish clear boundaries and interfaces between reusable Core Intelligence capabilities and the experiences they power.

**About You**

* 4\-year college degree or equivalent experience; advanced degree in technology, engineering, data science, business or a related field is a plus.
* 8\+ years of Product Management experience, preferably across highly technical, data\-intensive, AI/ML, platform or enterprise products.
* Demonstrated experience defining product strategy and leading complex product portfolios.
* Experience leading and developing Product Managers.
* Strong understanding of data\-driven products, AI/ML concepts, recommendation systems, intelligent platforms or related technology domains.
* Proven ability to translate complex technology into customer and business outcomes.
* Strong systems thinking and ability to connect multiple capabilities into a coherent product strategy.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and influence skills.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and solving problems where neither the solution nor the path is obvious.
* Experience working across global Product and Engineering organizations is strongly preferred.

title: ServiceNow Administrator
description:

We are looking for a ServiceNow Administrator to own the day\-to\-day health, hygiene and administration of our ServiceNow instances, so that AI workflow capability can be built and deployed on foundations that behave predictably.


You will own access and configuration control, run family release upgrades, manage environments and releases, and keep platform performance, data quality and licence position under control. This role is the difference between a platform that scales and one that slowly becomes a maintenance problem — and it carries the authority to say no to changes that would take us in the wrong direction.


What You Will Do:
**Key responsibiliteis include, but not limited too:*** Administering users, groups, roles and ACLs, and maintaining a defensible access model across instances.
* Maintaining core platform configuration including assignment rules, notifications, SLAs, service catalogue and reporting.
* Supporting the planning and running ServiceNow family release upgrades end to end — skipped\-update review, regression testing, remediation planning and post\-upgrade verification.
* Supporting the management of environments and releases: update set or source control promotion, clone scheduling and clean\-up, and pre\-production data integrity.
* Monitoring platform performance and health — scheduled jobs, transaction and log analysis, system diagnostics — and acting before issues reach users.
* Supporting CMDB and data quality, including discovery data integrity and the accuracy of CI relationships used by workflow and AI capability.
* Managing the licence and subscription position, including entitlement usage tracking and flagging commercial risk.
* Building and maintaining reports, dashboards and Performance Analytics content for operational and leadership use.
* Operating and enforcing change control, and maintaining accurate platform documentation and configuration records.
* Providing second\-line platform support to the Workflow Development team and to internal users, and resolving issues to root cause.


What You Will Have:
**What you will have:**

* Minimum **2\-4years** of experience as a ServiceNow Administrator.
* Proven experience as a ServiceNow Administrator in a complex enterprise environment, with strong knowledge of platform configuration and governance.
* Strong understanding of users, groups, roles, ACLs, environments, releases and change control.
* Experience supporting ServiceNow family upgrades, including testing, remediation and post\-upgrade validation.
* Good understanding of platform health, performance, CMDB, Discovery and data quality.
* Experience with ServiceNow reporting, dashboards, Performance Analytics and licence management.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues to root cause and proactively identify platform risks.
* A disciplined approach to documentation, governance and configuration management, with the confidence to challenge changes that could compromise platform stability.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with an interest in automation and AI\-enabled workflows.

title: Infrastructure Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

Your role
  

Step into the engine room of enterprise technology, where every decision you make can shape how a customer’s systems perform today \- and scale for tomorrow. You’ll dive deep into complex infrastructure environments, solving challenging technical problems, designing seamless integrations and ensuring systems run reliably at every level. Your expertise across networks, endpoints and mainframes, paired with a knack for logical problem\-solving and clear documentation, will guide projects from concept to execution. Your solutions will make a real impact that customers notice and remember.
  

  

In this role, you’ll balance hands\-on delivery with long\-term strategic planning. From analyzing issues and testing solutions to automating processes and integrating across platforms, your work will touch every layer of IT infrastructure. You’ll collaborate with Architects, Technicians and Project Managers, gaining broad exposure and continuous opportunities to grow your skills and influence.
  

Analyze and Solve, Diagnose complex issues across servers, networks, cloud environments and systems to identify root causes. Recommend solutions that balance technical feasibility, timelines and customer priorities. Test, refine and automate processes to improve reliability, efficiency and repeatability. Assess risks proactively and implement strategies to prevent disruptions
  

Design and Integrate, Plan end\-to\-end infrastructure solutions across platforms and technologies. Integrate systems in hybrid cloud and on\-prem environments to ensure seamless operation. Automate workflows and processes to streamline delivery and reduce errors. Document architectures and procedures for hand\-offs, knowledge sharing and operational continuity
  

  

Collaborate and Deliver, Coordinate cross\-functional teams including Architects, Project Managers and Technicians. Drive project delivery from initiation to completion with attention to quality and timelines. Communicate technical solutions clearly to customers and stakeholders. Build customer confidence by delivering tangible, high\-impact results, Grow and Advance, Expand technical expertise across cloud platforms, enterprise IT systems and emerging technologies, Earn certifications and qualifications while applying them on real projects, Pursue career paths toward Architect or Distinguished Engineer roles


**Your Future at Kyndryl**  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands\-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.  



  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.


**Required skills and experience**

* Deep expertise within specific technology domain areas (e.g., software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics)
* Enterprise IT application experience
* Hands\-on experience in at least one of the following: software development, DevOps engineering, systems administration, or systems architecture in public cloud AWS domain
In\-depth knowledge of Windows and Linux Operating System  
* 

  

**Preferred skills and experience**

* Familiar with a variety of IT concepts, practices, and procedures
* Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principals involved in production of precision technical plans, blueprints, drawings, and models
* Logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems
Analytical and problem\-solving skills with high attention to detail  
* 

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Regional Learning Manager, ATS
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon's Learning \& Development (L\&D) team within IN ATS Operations is seeking a highly experienced and results\-oriented Learning Manager to lead and scale strategic L\&D initiatives across our rapidly growing operations network. This is a pivotal role that sits at the intersection of talent strategy, learning innovation, and operational excellence — directly influencing how Amazon builds, develops, and retains world\-class talent at scale.  

  

The role will own end\-to\-end program management of high\-impact initiatives spanning the full L\&D value chain: from shaping the hiring strategy and building organizational capability (associates and managers) through programs, to driving content development, expanding centralized learning systems, and leading change management across the network. You will be the single\-threaded owner for programs such as Flex (ALFA), global learning benchmarks, and defect reduction — translating data into actionable learning interventions that move the needle on associate performance and operational quality.  

  

This role demands a leader who can operate at both the strategic and tactical level — someone who can present compelling L\&D narratives in Quarterly Business Reviews and Operational Planning forums to senior leadership, while simultaneously diving deep into data cuts to identify root causes and scope improvement opportunities. You will manage the L\&D budget with fiscal discipline, drive the expansion of learning technology infrastructure, and navigate the learning implications of externalization changes — all while maintaining focus on the associate experience.  

  

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination of program management expertise, analytical horsepower, learning domain knowledge, and the ability to influence without authority across operations, HR, quality, and technology teams. You thrive in ambiguity, move fast with purpose, and are energized by the opportunity to build mechanisms that scale learning impact across one of the world's most complex fulfillment networks.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Hiring Strategy: Own the end\-to\-end L\&D hiring strategy, including workforce planning, talent pipeline development, and role\-specific competency frameworks. Partner with Talent Acquisition to ensure timely and quality hiring aligned to business growth plans.  

ALFA Strategy: Evaluate and iterate on Flex Fulfillment Associate strategy — identify what is working, diagnose gaps, and drive continuous improvement through mechanism\-based interventions.  

Capability Building (GB \& BB): Design, launch, and scale capability building programs. Define success metrics, track certification throughput, and ensure programs are tied to operational improvement outcomes.  

Program Management: Own program management for new programs, global benchmarks. Drive cross\-functional alignment, establish milestones, manage risks, and report progress to senior leadership.  

QBR \& OP1: Prepare and present L\&D performance narratives for Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) and OP1 planning. Own the data story — translate learning metrics into business impact language that resonates with senior leaders.  

Defect Reduction: Lead defect reduction initiatives by generating data cuts that identify scope of improvement. Partner with operations and quality teams to prioritize high\-impact defect categories and design targeted learning interventions.  

Content Development: Own the end\-to\-end content development strategy and execution. Define content standards, manage the content creation pipeline, and ensure learning materials are current, engaging, and aligned to operational needs. Drive content effectiveness measurement and continuous improvement.  

Change Management: Lead change management initiatives related to learning programs and processes. Develop communication plans, stakeholder engagement strategies, and adoption frameworks to ensure smooth rollout of new learning initiatives across the network.  

Central Learning Systems Expansion: Drive the expansion and optimization of centralized learning systems and technology infrastructure. Evaluate platform capabilities, manage vendor relationships, and ensure systems scale to meet growing organizational needs.  

Learning: Manage learning implications of ATS externalization changes. Assess impact on training requirements, develop transition learning plans, and ensure associates impacted by externalization are equipped with the right skills and knowledge.  

L\&D Cost and Budgeting: Own the L\&D budget and cost management process. Develop annual budgets, track spend against plan, identify cost optimization opportunities, and provide regular financial reporting to leadership.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience analyzing business metrics and training data to measure program effectiveness
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams
* Experience developing and implementing training programs
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2\+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience creating learning content and driving learning through a Learning Management System
